message: I recently found myself in the middle of a power outage, and it turned out to be a delightful excuse to unplug and rediscover some low-tech fun! I dusted off some board games and even tried my hand at candle-lit journaling. If you’re curious about how to make the most of these moments, the Red Cross has some great tips on preparing for blackouts. What’s your favorite way to enjoy time without electricity?
